title: OpenAI: Web search tool call sources are not included in tool result chunk
body:
### Description

When a web call tool result is received, AI SDK currently enqueues a `tool-result` chunk (irrespective of success or failure - https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/9270). The input field of this `tool-result` chunk is set to the action returned in the tool call result. However, `sources` property is not defined in the Zod schema of the `search` action type. See:

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/418e18f15129e4615f5200c64c535c40b688cff6/packages/openai/src/responses/openai-responses-language-model.ts#L1011-L1025

https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/418e18f15129e4615f5200c64c535c40b688cff6/packages/openai/src/responses/openai-responses-language-model.ts#L40-L49

So, sources array is completely missed.

### AI SDK Version

- @ai-sdk/openai: 2.0.44
- ai: 5.0.60
